gen-gf-grandstander-gf-halant: Grandstander draws bold, expressive letters in plain constant-width lines, with short ascenders and a tall x-height. And Halant, a serif with outward-pointing terminals and a faint thick-thin shift, carries a longer read with a towering x-height and quiet authority.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-headland-one: Dignified is Headland One's whole manner, a text serif with letters spaced well apart and gentle stroke variation. Grandstander, bent from a single wire and bold, sits above it, so try the heading a good deal bigger.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-hedvig-letters-se: Authoritative and classic, Hedvig Letters Serif has open-ended curves and stems that outweigh its hairlines just a little. Grandstander's wire-even strokes take the heading and give that sturdy serif something playful to lean against.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-marcellus-sc: Grandstander writes like a marker nib, bold and indifferent to stroke direction. Marcellus SC, a text serif with moderate swelling and pulled-back terminals, gives that loose energy a literary, dignified anchor underneath.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-montagu-slab: Grandstander gives the heading a smooth drawn-wire feel, bold and expressive, with short ascenders and a tall x-height throughout. Montagu Slab, a text serif with sturdy downstrokes, can sit a notch smaller.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-serif-hentai: Grandstander's tubular, wire-like letterforms feel bold and expressive, with a tall x-height and short ascenders above the text. Noto Serif Hentaigana feels refined beside it, a serif with middling contrast and open jaws.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-ovo: Ovo reads as a classic text serif, its thins only slightly lighter than its thicks and its curve terminals spacious. Beside it, Grandstander's tubular, wire-like heading gives the page a bold, expressive front.
gen-gf-gugi-fs-bespoke-slab: Gugi opens with distinctive, bold lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals, its terminals cut open so counters flow outward. Bespoke Slab, a classic serif with tall bodies, grounds it with refined, steadier ground.
gen-gf-gugi-fs-erode: No stress axis tilts Gugi's round letters, so its tall lowercase and open-cut terminals look bold and distinctive. And Erode, a classic serif with a gentle ebb and flow of weight, would carry long text with an editorial, dignified ease.
gen-gf-gugi-fs-hoover: Distinctive and bold, Gugi builds its stems and arches at identical thickness, with tall lowercase and open-cut terminals. Hoover, a serif with a generous entry into the e, is refined enough to sit smaller below.
